payload.title: Creating Murmuration Plots for Glacial Data
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the use of the Pyleoclim library to calculate correlations between speleothem oxygen isotope data and insolation at various latitudes, focusing on glacial periods. It includes defining a function to handle correlations in records with large hiatuses, creating insolation curves using Climlab, and generating glacial period-specific data records. The notebook culminates in the creation of murmuration plots to visualize these correlations.
